import unittest
import math
from solution import ParcelLedger


class ParcelLedgerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def record(self, parcel_id='p1', mass=4, x=1.5, y=-2, labels=None):
        return {'parcel_id': parcel_id, 'mass': mass,
                'position': {'x': x, 'y': y},
                'labels': ['fragile'] if labels is None else labels}

    def test_put_get_replace_and_order(self):
        ledger = ParcelLedger()
        self.assertIsNone(ledger.get('missing'))
        self.assertEqual(ledger.all_records(), [])
        ledger.put(self.record('z', 8))
        ledger.put(self.record('a', 0, 0, 0, []))
        ledger.put(self.record('z', 9, 3, 4, ['new']))
        self.assertEqual([r['parcel_id'] for r in ledger.all_records()], ['a', 'z'])
        self.assertEqual(ledger.get('z'), self.record('z', 9, 3, 4, ['new']))

    def test_deep_copy_on_put_and_retrieval(self):
        ledger = ParcelLedger()
        source = self.record(labels=['a', 'b'])
        ledger.put(source)
        source['position']['x'] = 999
        source['labels'].append('changed')
        source['mass'] = 20
        got = ledger.get('p1')
        self.assertEqual(got, self.record(labels=['a', 'b']))
        got['position']['y'] = 999
        got['labels'].clear()
        all_got = ledger.all_records()
        all_got[0]['labels'].append('outside')
        self.assertEqual(ledger.get('p1'), self.record(labels=['a', 'b']))
        self.assertIsNot(ledger.get('p1'), ledger.get('p1'))

    def test_invalid_records_do_not_change_state(self):
        ledger = ParcelLedger()
        good = self.record()
        ledger.put(good)
        invalid = [
            None, [],
            {'parcel_id': 'x', 'mass': 1, 'position': {'x': 0, 'y': 0}},
            dict(good, extra=1),
            dict(good, parcel_id=''), dict(good, parcel_id=3),
            dict(good, mass=-1), dict(good, mass=True), dict(good, mass=1.2),
            dict(good, position=[]),
            dict(good, position={'x': 0, 'y': 0, 'z': 0}),
            dict(good, position={'x': math.inf, 'y': 0}),
            dict(good, position={'x': True, 'y': 0}),
            dict(good, labels='fragile'),
            dict(good, labels=['ok', 2]),
        ]
        before = ledger.all_records()
        for value in invalid:
            with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                ledger.put(value)
            self.assertEqual(ledger.all_records(), before)

    def test_error_categories_for_representative_values(self):
        ledger = ParcelLedger()
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            ledger.put([])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            ledger.put(self.record(mass=True))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ledger.put(self.record(parcel_id=''))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ledger.put(self.record(mass=-1))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ledger.put(self.record(x=math.nan))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
